description: This Dart file defines a mock implementation of a chat service used for testing purposes within a Flutter project. It simulates an offline chat service that bypasses network calls, providing deterministic responses to facilitate testing of the application's chat and ReAct loop workflows.

classes.name: MockChatService
classes.description: A mock implementation of the ChatService interface that provides deterministic, offline responses for testing the chat flow without network connectivity.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Simulates sending a message by returning a predetermined response sequence to mimic a chat agent's behavior during testing.
